text:
ColliePWA

 
 
 
 

 
 Try it in your browser — no install ·
 colliepwa.dev 
 A real Collie build running in the page against faked data. 
 

ColliePWA is an open-source (MIT) web app for your phone. It displays your terminal AI agents,
including Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, and lets you answer them remotely. You host it on your
own computer alongside Herdr. Support for the new Herdr core,
tmux, zellij, tuios, Tern and Rex is
experimental. ColliePWA is served over Tailscale, so only devices on your own tailnet reach it. You install it via your browser
directly to your home screen, bypassing app stores.

Using Herdr? Read about the
Herdr mobile client.

 What you can do

- Answer what needs you. The dashboard surfaces waiting agents first. Agent prompts turn into
 buttons. Quick replies, a configurable keys board, and your system keyboard with voice
 dictation handle input. Guide
- WalkyTalky: agents message each other, and you message them. Send short messages between
 agent sessions across programs and machines. Message any session from your phone. Every message
 returns a receipt. WalkyTalky
- Start agents from the phone. Use the + New page to choose the machine, agent or
 command, directory, and an optional git worktree. Guide
- Push notifications and voice input. Receive alerts when an agent pauses or finishes.
 Whistle, Collie's built-in speech engine, converts voice to text. It remains inactive until
 configured. Voice and push
- See what the agent changed. The Files view displays the workspace folder, marks modified
 files, and provides a read-only view of git diffs and the latest commit. Changes
- Crews. Cluster multiple Collie hosts behind one URL with manual failover.
 Crews
- Tricks, and the Hill. Add small programs that put counts, marks and screens in Collie. Let
 an agent or a trick ask you one question, and answer it with one tap.
 Tricks, The Hill

Other features: output search, full conversation history, image and file attachments,
durable agents (experimental), four themes, twelve
languages, and per-device typeface selection. The Edge release line typesets chat equations when
math is enabled (syntax). Edge receives features before Stable
(Manage & update).

 Get it on your phone in 3 steps

Prerequisites: Tailscale on your computer and phone, and
Herdr (or experimental Herdr core, tmux, zellij, tuios, Tern or Rex) running on your computer.
For new setups, follow Install in five minutes for
platform-specific instructions, including Windows.
Alternative options (Arch, Nix, Herdr plugin, source) are in Install .

 1. Install on your computer. Requires curl , tar , and a sha256 utility. Needs no sudo or
compiler. Verifies checksums automatically:

 

 2. Start it on your tailnet:

 

Without COLLIE MUX , collie start checks for Herdr, tmux, and zellij and prompts you to pick
one. It offers Herdr core only if the Herdr TUI is absent. It never looks for tuios, Tern or Rex:
name one with COLLIE MUX .

 3. Put it on your phone and pair it. Run collie qr and scan the code. Add ColliePWA to
your home screen:

- iPhone: In Safari, tap Share (under ⋯ in the default iOS 26 layout), tap
 Add to Home Screen , then tap Add .
- Android: In Chrome, open Collie Settings and tap Install on the top card.

 

ColliePWA is not on the App Store or Google Play; home-screen installation is required. Launch the
installed app, run collie pair on your computer, and enter the code under
 Settings → Devices and machines → Paired devices . Pair within the home-screen app, not the browser: iOS keeps
their storage separate. The app displays no panes until paired.

Agents awaiting input appear first. Tap an agent to reply. To configure Collie using an agent,
instruct it to run collie skill and follow the instructions.

 Collie exposes remote shell access to your machine. Keep it on your tailnet ( tailscale serve ,
 never funnel ). Read Security before running.

 Security, read this first

 Collie provides remote shell access to your machine by design. A single Collie API call sends
arbitrary keystrokes directly into a live terminal pane. Anyone with access to the URL can read pane
output (source code, secrets, environment variables, agent output) and execute arbitrary commands
with your full user privileges. There is no sandbox and no command allow-list, as these would defeat
the core workflow. Treat the URL as a root login: bind it strictly to your tailnet, set
 COLLIE TRUSTED USER , and pair only the physical phone you are using. Read
 docs/security.md for details on the security model, defense layers, and
device gating before running the service.

 Never tailscale funnel this. funnel exposes the port to the public internet, whereas
 serve limits access to your private tailnet. Do not funnel Collie under any circumstances.

 Who this is for

Collie is for developers running terminal-multiplexed AI agents who want phone access via a touch
UI instead of an emulated terminal. Herdr is the primary target. The Herdr core, tmux, zellij,
tuios, Tern and Rex are experimental : they function, but testing is limited.
Bug reports are welcome, including reports
of working setups.

The setup assumes a Tailscale tailnet , with tailscale serve as the
default ingress. Collie is strictly single-user : one operator per tailnet, without multi-tenant
authentication. Do not deploy it for shared or public access.

 Demo

The interactive demo
runs the client in your browser against mock data without requiring installation.

 
 
 Dashboard : every pane stays in its workspace, what needs you is marked in place 
 Ask : the agent's own prompts become tappable buttons 
 
 
 Space : its tabs and panes, deep-linkable 
 Keys : the special-keys pad, arranged the way you work 
 
 
 Quick : your own one-tap replies, from quick-replies.toml 
 Settings : appearance, language, typeface, per device

install.title: Deployment variants
install.html:
Collie always binds to loopback only. Deployment types differ by ingress configuration and authentication mechanism. Variant A is default. See docs/deployment.md for variants B through E.

Variant A — tailscale serve + person identity (default)

Standard path from Install. tailscale serve terminates TLS on your MagicDNS domain and injects Tailscale-User-Login, a header a client cannot forge through the proxy. Define COLLIE_TRUSTED_USER in .env to restrict access:

COLLIE_TRUSTED_USER=you@example.com

This trusts the tailnet user, not the device. For device-level security, pair the device. Use alternative variants only for proxy setups or environments without Tailscale:

  • B, identity-aware proxy, authorised by device: Host-level proxy with role-based access.
  • C, reverse proxy as the only front door: Direct reverse proxy without Tailscale.
  • D, off-host identity proxy over the tailnet: Shared ingress node routing traffic to Collie and other systems.
  • E, any other mesh or tunnel: Custom network tunnels (NetBird, ZeroTier, Cloudflare Tunnel).
